note: Decoding is identical across all 9 directions so drift figures are comparable between them (CLAUDE.md §8, T-104). Changing any value here invalidates comparisons against artefacts produced under the old fingerprint. use_cache=false is REQUIRED, not a tuning choice: IndicTrans2's remote modelling code reads past_key_values as a legacy tuple, but modern transformers passes a Cache object that is non-None yet empty on the first step, so the model's `is not None` guard passes and it crashes on .shape. See CLAUDE.md §3.2. early_stopping was removed because transformers reports it as an invalid flag and ignores it; keeping it would imply a setting that is not in effect.
